Improve auto-rollback reliability: fix --reason parsing, clarify BOOT.md integration, add dependency/path validation, and harden release documentation.

Auto-rollback protection for openclaw.json modifications using launchd

- Documentation and metadata updates only; no code or functional changes.
- SKILL.md was reformatted and updated, but all workflows, features, and usage remain unchanged.

Initial release: Automatic configuration rollback system for OpenClaw on macOS.

- Backs up configs and sets a 10-minute auto-rollback before any openclaw.json changes.
- Integrates with launchd to schedule auto-restore if Gateway restart fails.
- Provides CLI tools: start rollback, cancel if Gateway boots, check status, and manual rollback.
- Automatically cancels rollback after a successful Gateway start via boot hook.
- Only one active rollback protection at a time; all actions are logged for traceability.
